description: This file defines a web page code-behind class for the AdminCourseQueue page in an online examination system. It includes event handlers for button clicks and grid view selection, facilitating navigation between pages in the admin portal.

classes.name: AdminCourseQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminCourseQueue ASP.NET page, handling UI events and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Page load event handler, currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'home' button, navigates to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'profile' button, currently empty.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'leaderboard' button, navigates to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'logout' button, navigates to LoginPage.aspx.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection in GridView2, stores selected course ID in session, and transfers to AdminCourseQueue.aspx.
